title: Trade-In Agreements Policy: Cancellation of an Accepted Agreement
content:
**Clause 1. Causes.** An accepted agreement under **Trade-In Agreements** ends before pickup when the customer withdraws, when the customer declines an adjusted offer at pickup, when the pickup window passes without a pickup, or, when the cancel-on-purchase-cancellation switch is true, when the linked purchase order is cancelled before pickup.

**Clause 2. Effect.** Nothing is credited or deducted on a cancelled agreement, and any quote recorded on it lapses with it.

**Clause 3. After pickup.** Once the vehicle is picked up the agreement can no longer be cancelled; a customer who wants the vehicle back after pickup is not provided for under Trade-In Agreements.

## Clause 1 by cause

| Cause | Ends the accepted agreement |
|---|---|
| Customer withdraws before pickup | Yes |
| Customer declines an adjusted offer at pickup (where the grade allows declining at pickup) | Yes |
| Pickup window passes without a pickup | Yes |
| Linked purchase order cancelled before pickup | Yes, when the cancel-on-purchase-cancellation switch is true |

## Points of judgement

- **Status that can be cancelled.** Only an accepted agreement; a picked-up agreement cannot be cancelled under Clause 3.
- **Quotes.** A payoff quote recorded on an agreement that is cancelled lapses with the agreement.
- **Hypothetical:** a customer whose vehicle was collected yesterday asks to undo the trade. The agreement is picked up, so Clause 3 applies and it is not cancelled.
